title: Smooth lattice 3-polytopes with seven facets have the integer decomposition property

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India

creators.name: Bhattacharya, Ushashi
creators.affiliation: Formerly, National Taiwan University, Taipei 106319, Taiwan

description:
We prove that every smooth lattice polytope in dimension three with seven facets has the integer decomposition property. The proof classifies the normal fans and settles each by one of three criteria; it is independent of the recent proofs of Oda's conjecture in dimension three by M. Michałek and by J. Curtis and G. Liu (arXiv:2610.17270), which use lattice width and of which this theorem is a special case.

The archive contains the paper (PDF, LaTeX source in the style of The Electronic Journal of Combinatorics, arXiv tarball), the certificates of the 625 families of smooth projective fans with seven rays, independent checkers in C, C++, Julia and Python, and a Lean 4 project with Mathlib in which the kernel checks every certificate for every value of the parameters (no native_decide; axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound only). The reduction to the second dilate, the three criteria and the classification of the fans are proved by hand in the paper.
